title: Can LLM-Simulated Respondents Pre-Test Survey Questions? Evidence From Preregistered Prospective Validation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31532v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be conditioned to simulate behavioral responses, including survey responses, but it remains unclear whether and how these simulations can support downstream research tasks. Here, we evaluate whether simulated respondents can support pre-testing new candidate survey questions before fielding them, operationalized as prioritizing candidate survey items. Specifically, we rank candidate questions by their mean responses, which can reveal ceiling or floor effects; their variance, which indicates whether responses contain meaningful variation; and differences between subpopulations, which indicate whether questions capture distinctions between relevant groups within a population. We introduce a preregistered, prospective evaluation that commits model predictions before target human responses exist, ruling out memorization of those responses by design. translated_title: LLM模拟的受访者能否对调查问题进行预测试？来自预注册前瞻性验证的证据
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以被调控以模拟行为反应，包括调查问卷的回答，但这些模拟是否以及如何能够支持下游研究任务仍不清楚。在此，我们评估了模拟受访者是否能够支持在正式发放新调查问题之前对其进行预测试，具体操作为对候选调查项目进行优先级排序。具体而言，我们根据候选问题的平均回答对其进行排序——这可以揭示天花板效应或地板效应；根据其方差进行排序——这表明回答中是否包含有意义的变化；以及根据子群体之间的差异进行排序——这表明问题是否能够捕捉到人群中相关群体之间的区别。我们引入了一项预注册的前瞻性评估，在目标人类回答数据存在之前就提交模型预测，从而从设计上排除了模型对这些回答的记忆。使用两轮本地调查数据（2025年：N = 1,271；2026年：N……）
tldr: 该研究通过预注册的前瞻性验证设计，证明LLM模拟的受访者能够在真实人类回答数据产生之前，通过平均回答、方差和子群体差异三个指标对候选调查问题进行排序，从而有效支持新调查问题的预测试。
en_tdlr: This preregistered prospective validation study demonstrates that LLM-simulated respondents can effectively pre-test new survey questions by ranking candidate items based on mean responses, variance, and subpopulation differences before any human response data exist.
